label: Human left atrium, donor D6 (Visium)
why: ADORA1 is the cardiac adenosine receptor (it slows the heart). In this donor the atrium detects it in 12% of spots, against 2% in the same donor's ventricle (next section). Same lab, donor and OCT protocol, so the contrast is not a batch artefact between studies.
collection: Spatially resolved multiomics of human cardiac niches
